description: Capability for the selection review floater window: listens for selection:review / insert:fallback, runs the provider stream (plugin HTTP), and drives hide/insert via app commands.

permissions.comment: InsertGo.AI only, matching the main window and the skill bar. The floater's only request is the provider run, and that resolves to `${API_URL}/api/ai/generate` (services/lanes.ts -> aiProviders.ts) — never to a model host. The previous `https://**` rule existed for BYOK, which is a decided non-feature (R-15, 2026-08-08); it left the one window that streams user text able to POST it to any host on the internet.
